cases.original: We would like to bring to your attention the fact that your subscription will be expiring in the near future.
cases.note: Grammatical, but a nominal fact-clause and a stacked time phrase say what two words can.

cases.original: I am agree with the proposal, and I will do a presentation next week for the team.
cases.suggestion: I agree with the proposal, and I will give a presentation to the team next week.
cases.note: 'I am agree' is a clear error that follows the Romance 'estoy de acuerdo'. 'Do a presentation' is informal; 'give' or 'make' is the conventional wording in formal writing (a preference, medium confidence).

cases.original: Hey there! Oopsie, your payment didn't go through lol. Try again, k?
cases.suggestion: Your payment did not go through. Please try again.
cases.note: Banking error copy: playful slang is out of register and reads as dismissive.

cases.original: Please colour the centre panel and select a favorite theme before you customize your licence.
cases.suggestion: Please colour the centre panel and select a favourite theme before you customize your licence.
cases.note: en-GB text with the American spelling 'favorite' beside British 'colour', 'centre', 'licence'. Oxford '-ize' in 'customize' is acceptable British spelling and is left alone.

cases.original: The report that the analyst who the team that we hired last year trained wrote was approved.
cases.suggestion: The report was approved. The analyst who wrote it was trained by the team we hired last year.
cases.note: Grammatical centre-embedding that a reader cannot parse on one pass.

cases.original: Your changes are saved automatically. You can close this window at any time.
cases.note: Natural, clear, correct register. A reviewer should report no findings.

cases.original: In today's fast-paced digital landscape, our innovative platform seamlessly empowers teams to unlock their full potential.
cases.suggestion: Our platform helps teams reach their full potential.
cases.note: Formulaic opener and stacked adjectives. The revision drops them and keeps the one claim the author made. The concrete benefit is the author's to supply.

cases.original: In order to check your DotBabel setup, you will need to run the command `dotbabel doctor` after installing `@dotbabel/dotbabel`.
cases.suggestion: To check your DotBabel setup, run `dotbabel doctor` after installing `@dotbabel/dotbabel`.
cases.note: The product name and the commands stay exactly as written.

cases.original: In order to check your DotBabel setup, you will need to run the command `dotbabel doctor` after installing `@dotbabel/dotbabel`.
cases.suggestion: To check your DotBabel setup, run `dotbabel diagnose` after installing `@dotbabel/dotbabel`.
cases.note: A revision must never reword a command inside a code span.

cases.original: {count, plural, one {There is # item that is currently located in your cart.} other {There are # items that are currently located in your cart.}}
cases.suggestion: {count, plural, one {Your cart has # item.} other {Your cart has # items.}}
cases.note: ICU skeleton, selectors and # markers are untouched; only the prose changed.

cases.original: {count, plural, one {There is # item that is currently located in your cart.} other {There are # items that are currently located in your cart.}}
cases.suggestion: {count, plural, one {Your cart has one item.} other {Your cart has several items.}}
cases.note: Replacing # with words loses the number.

cases.original: Click Save in order to save the changes for {name}. See the help page.
cases.suggestion: Click Save to save the changes for {name}. See the help page.
cases.note: Tags, the href, and the placeholder are intact. Only 'in order' is dropped; the verb still matches the button label.

cases.suggestion: Click Save to save the changes for {username}. See the help page.
cases.note: Dropped <b> tags and a renamed placeholder.

findings.original: Hey there! Oopsie, your payment didn't go through lol. Try again, k?
findings.suggestion: Your payment did not go through. Please try again.
findings.explanation: Playful slang in an error about money reads as dismissive. A neutral sentence states the problem and the next step.

findings.original: We would like to bring to your attention the fact that your subscription will be expiring in the near future.
findings.explanation: The fact-clause and the stacked time phrase add length without adding meaning.
